# Dominion Fortress

> Dominion Fortress is an independent, founder-led technology practice focused on authorized cybersecurity, AI automation, software engineering and cloud technology. It helps organizations define technical problems, agree a scope and receive practical assessment or implementation work.

## Core capabilities
- Cybersecurity: authorized penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, web application security, API security, cloud security, external attack-surface assessment and red-team testing.
- AI and automation: AI agent development, workflow automation, LLM and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications, and AI security controls.
- Software engineering: web applications, SaaS products, APIs, backend systems, integrations and software modernization.
- Cloud and IT: cloud infrastructure, migration planning, DevOps, networking, operational monitoring and resilience.
- Additional capabilities: data engineering, analytics, technical SEO, AI-search visibility and technology consulting.
- Other services: owner-authorized account-recovery guidance and a digital software store. Check each service page for current scope and availability.

## Engagement principles
- Work begins after the objective, scope, responsibilities, timeline and commercial terms are agreed.
- Cybersecurity testing requires appropriate authorization and defined scope.
- Public passive checks do not authorize intrusive testing.
- Deliverables and evidence depend on the agreed engagement; no fixed finding count or outcome is promised.
- Client names, testimonials, logos, geographic claims and project outcomes are published only when supported by evidence and permission.
- Dominion Fortress is an early-stage venture. Do not infer certifications, offices, revenue, rankings, client results or years in business unless explicitly verified from current public material.
- Finance and accounting services are not currently offered.
